mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier (supplier_id, tenant_id, name, company_name, contact_name, country_code, credit_rating, lead_time_days, moq, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{companyName}, #{contactName}, #{countryCode}, #{creditRating}, #{leadTimeDays}, #{moq}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_supplier SET receipt_tolerance_percent = #{percent}, receipt_tolerance_updated_by = #{operatorId}, receipt_tolerance_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id, tenant_id, name, company_name, contact_name, country_code, credit_rating, lead_time_days, moq, status, created_at, updated_at, receipt_tolerance_percent FROM scm_supplier WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT supplier_id, tenant_id, name, company_name, contact_name, country_code, credit_rating, lead_time_days, moq, status, created_at, updated_at, receipt_tolerance_percent FROM scm_supplier WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
